cases.explain: «иссохшей рукой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He said to the man who had his hand withered, “Stand up.”

cases.sentence: Тогда Иисус, обведя их ___ и скорбя о черствости их сердец, сказал тому человеку:
cases.explain: «гневным взглядом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.”  He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

cases.sentence: А те, в ком были ___, когда видели Его, падали перед Ним ниц и кричали:
cases.explain: «нечистые духи» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

cases.sentence: Ведь никто не может войти в дом ___ и разграбить его добро, если сначала не свяжет его, — только тогда можно будет ограбить его дом.
cases.explain: «сильного человека» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
